name: procure-sherpa
description: A single-file, offline-first procurement learning and decision-support tool: competency curriculum, digital SOPs, checklists, templates, 19 financial calculators, decision guides and inline analytics. Runs from one HTML file with no server, no database, no accounts and no telemetry; all state is per-browser localStorage.

scripts.qa: node build.mjs && eslint . && node tools/check_rels.mjs && node tools/test_calcs.mjs && node tools/test_calc_values.mjs && node tools/test_interactive.mjs && node tools/test_quiz_tips.mjs && node tools/smoke.mjs && node tools/security_audit.mjs && node tools/a11y_audit.mjs && node tools/perf_check.mjs && node tools/i18n_audit.mjs && npm run verify:min
scripts.test: node build.mjs && node tools/test_calcs.mjs && node tools/test_calc_values.mjs && node tools/smoke.mjs
scripts.verify:min: node tools/build_min.mjs && node tools/smoke.mjs dist/index.html && node tools/test_calcs.mjs dist/index.html && node tools/test_calc_values.mjs dist/index.html && node tools/a11y_audit.mjs dist/index.html
